content.description: Complete EFI system schematic showing fuel system, air induction system, and electronic control system components and their interconnections

content.text: The EFI used on Toyotas has three basic systems.

An electric fuel pump supplies sufficient fuel, under a constant pressure, to the EFI injectors. These injectors inject a metered quantity of fuel into the intake manifold in accordance with signals from the ECU. Each injector injects, at the same time, one half of the fuel required for ideal combustion with each engine revolution.
The air induction system provides sufficient air for engine operation.

The 5M-GE engine is equipped with a Toyota Computer Control System (TCCS) which centrally controls the EFI, ESA, EGR, Diagnosis systems, etc. by means of Electronic Control Unit (ECU — formerly EFI computer) employing a microcomputer.
